announcements.msg: 3.7.1-STABLE is live on the green channel. All 2.40.x builds are patched — do not install them.
2.58.3 moved to yellow: works, but run it on a second account only.

versions.name: 3.7.1-STABLE
versions.desc: Current production build. Verified working on arm64-v8a with Magisk 27+ and KernelSU. Overlay at layer 2003, config delivery live.
steps: Download the APK from the releases page on your device
Allow installs from unknown apps for your browser or file manager
Grant the superuser prompt when the panel asks (UID 0 required)
Enable Display over other apps so the overlay can render
Activate your license key and wait for OK
Launch the floating panel inside a match

versions.name: 2.58.3-LEGACY
versions.desc: Older stable line. Still attaches cleanly, but detection heat is higher on this build — second account strongly advised.
steps: Uninstall any newer build first to avoid signature conflicts
Install and grant root, then enable Display over other apps
Use a second account only — do not log your main here

versions.name: 2.40.0-PATCHED
versions.desc: Server-side patched. Installs but hooks never attach; kept in the archive for reference only.

proofs.text: Chams through solid walls, full squad wipe
Skeletal wireframes holding steady at range
Drop radar tracking crates across the zone
Legacy build overlay still attaching clean
